Then there's our President, Harry Hare, having all his superfluous fat massaged away by Tommy Eaton's magic paws. Then in barges Footer, barking like a mongrel with pneumonia, after a "tear-up" with the boys.

Tom Eaton took such a fancy to our surroundings that he alighted to get a "close-up" and got left. His cross-country experience, however, did not fail him, for he went "as the crow flies," and on our arrival we found him awaiting us.

Here Tommy Eaton, whom many of you will know as our pre-war trainer, was the virtual scratch man together with Alf Pateman. Harry followed with a second prize at the Tottenham Hospital Sports and a first prize at Sutton.
